Under the coined spelling tubuild.apply_compiler_only_policy refuses a deadstrip-data row for having no configured ROM home, and refuses a plain deadstrip because an RTTI record taking that disposition is never compared against the cartridge. Renaming the class to its cartridge RTTI spelling is the unblocker; it is a separate change and is not made here.
